purpose: Revise the worked example so that RT nesting is shown as an ordered continuation process: continuation, normalization, RT closure, domain rebinding, role occupancy, and candidate nested RT formation.

provenance_alignment.note: This revision is aligned to the proposed registry candidate and remains documentation-only until the registry gate accepts PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_046.

non_claims: Does not assert universal RT occupancy.
Does not identify OPEN_BRIDGE_001 closure with basin closure.
Does not promote <*>_x from meta-language construct to proof operator.

canonical_pipeline: Explicit domain rebinding into receiving domain x
Role occupancy as A-slot or E-slot

premises: C_A denotes a candidate continuation intended for possible A-slot occupancy.
C_E denotes a candidate continuation intended for possible E-slot occupancy.
NF(C_A) yields CompletedRT_A only if C_A closes under the governing RT condition.
NF(C_E) yields CompletedRT_E only if C_E closes under the governing RT condition.
x declares the shared receiving nesting domain.
S denotes the shared substrate/scale of the receiving A|E window.
r records residue/history for the enclosing window.

admissibility_rule.statement: A completed RT may appear in an A-slot or E-slot only after it is explicitly rebound into the receiving domain x and typed according to the slot it occupies.
admissibility_rule.forbidden_inference: RT(X) alone does not imply automatic admissibility into A or E.

swap_test.interpretation: The swapped construction must be checked independently. If admissibility changes under swap, A/E occupancy is role-asymmetric or domain-dependent.

audit_results_supported_by_this_revision: The example supports candidate slot occupancy only under explicit rebinding.
The example supports the ordering: closure precedes rebinding; rebinding precedes occupancy.
The example does not prove role symmetry.
The example does not prove universal nesting.
The example preserves the distinction between R as relation and r as residue/history.

required_followup.note: A structural worked witness now exists, but a content-filled operational example is still needed.

required_followup.task: Cross-check basin closure against OPEN_BRIDGE_001 closure.
Determine whether A-slot and E-slot admissibility are symmetric, asymmetric, or domain-dependent.
Delay textbook correction until a content-filled example validates.

agent_instruction: Replace DOC_WORKED_EXAMPLE_046 with this revision only as a provisional documentation artifact. Do not promote Patch 046 to applied status, do not update RT_core, and do not modify textbook surfaces until CHECK_046_A is fully satisfied by a content-filled operational example.
